notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned all 600 targets under frozen rubric. No other 068 annotations, gold, legacy/external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal choices and validated exact contiguous original-language quotes, schema and UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. Unfinished work stayed outside initiative. Explicit absence and below-threshold findings distinguished in notes; missing severity/extent/acuity/anatomy and contradictions masked. Only completion/coverage/hashes shared with root; flags withheld pending independent source-first review. Draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
